positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (Machine Learning) | Technical Lead
Data Scientist (Cyber Analytics)
positions.description:
Data science meets cyber security. I develop detection models for cyber security anomalies and threats. 
Areas of interest:
1) Translation of conventional signal processing techniques to the cyber space for feature engineering
2) Experimentation of deep learning applications for cyber threat classification
3) Mining relationships and grouping entities using graph-based techniques

4) Distributed algorithms

Published work: "Fast convolution formulation for radar detection using LASSO" in IEEE SSP 2016

projects.title: 3D Computational Microscope: NoScope
projects.description:
- NoScope is a novel 3D lensless microscope that we developed from scratch. By removing the need for expensive optical lenses, we aim to demonstrate the feasibility of cheap computational microscopy.
- My Role: Development of the 3D reconstruction and super-resolution algorithm. Formulated the reconstruction as an inverse (deconvolution) problem, using 4D light-field as the propagation model.
- Project Advisor: Prof Laura Waller
- Thesis: https://www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Pubs/TechRpts/2015/EECS-2015-52.html

publications.title: Fast Convolution Formulations for Radar Detection using LASSO
publications.publisher: 2016 IEEE Workshop on Statistical Signal Processing · Aug 25, 2016
